capabilities: Insert current time rounded to a chosen interval
Insert start and end times with computed duration
Insert saved phrases and random affirmation lines
Copy a heading section to the clipboard
disambiguation: Not a habit tracker or progress tool; it only inserts time, date and phrase text into notes.
extras: Works fully offline with no network requests; settings are stored in the plugin's data file in the vault, and the clipboard is written only when copying a heading section. Settings and command names are available in English and Korean.
motivation: Made for people who grow by writing things down: daily logs, journals, habit notes, study notes.
problem: Typing timestamps, dates and durations by hand in logs and journals is slow on mobile, and there is no quick way to copy a whole heading section.
summary: Toolbar buttons that insert times, dates, start and end times with duration, saved phrases and random affirmations, and copy a heading section.
